goal: Trade and caravans: build a market stall, buy and sell, get a Storehouse and send a caravan. Check specifically that residents of YOUR own settlement leave the market stalls to you (they should not fill your market), and that the 'Build a market stall' objective completes only from a stall you build.

findings.title: A freshly built own market cannot trade at all: Sell and Purchase Food both fail, yet Market Info shows live prices
findings.detail: Right after building the first stall in my settlement (resident Nancy Walker becomes its merchant), Sell Resources says 'No merchant here can pay: the richest has 0 coins, and your cheapest good (sapling) sells for 19.' and Purchase Food says 'No one is selling food at this market...'. Still the same ~8 game seconds later. Meanwhile the Market Info panel lists buy/sell prices with trend arrows for 9 goods, which reads as a working market. Expected: either the new stall is seeded with a little coin/stock, or the panel says the merchant has nothing to trade yet. As a player whose goal is 'buy and sell', I had 437 coins and 31 apples and could do neither. Sell also offers saplings first as 'cheapest good', which is surprising.
findings.repro: pt start --seed 105; gather 50 wood, N, F on open ground, E to enter, gather 20 wood + 5 stone, H, E, B; click Sell Resources (187,444) and Purchase Food (66,444)

findings.title: Caravans are locked behind Town era and Storehouse needs 30 stone: out of reach of a 30-minute trade session
findings.detail: Inside my settlement the 'Send Caravan (Town era)' button is greyed; Town is era 3 of 4 (Camp -> Village needs 10 members, 2 buildings, 2 stalls, day 3). The Storehouse costs 10 wood + 30 stone. With the game running at 3-14 tps on a shared machine, reaching the stall objective took ~22 real minutes, so the caravan half of the goal was unreachable. A player hunting for the trade loop will see the caravan button almost immediately but not be able to use it for hours of play.
findings.repro: as above; enter own settlement and look at the 'Send Caravan (Town era)' button

findings.title: Found-settlement 'open ground lies to the north' hint leads into another camp's exclusion zone; no compass on screen
findings.detail: Pressing F at (12,225) in Redton's land said 'Open ground lies about 180 to the north'. After sprinting ~190 units north, F said 'Too close to the Camp of Easternland: 91 away, and settlements must be 250 apart. Open ground lies about 160 to the east.' (a camp was founded meanwhile, or the hint ignored it). Following east then worked. There is no compass/minimap or heading indicator, so 'north' cannot be followed from the screen alone.
findings.repro: pt start --seed 105; collect 50 wood near spawn via pt walkto tree; F at ~(12,225); walk north; F again

findings.title: HUD layout breaks inside own settlement: Inventory panel jumps to screen centre, objective bar text clipped, giant floating resident label
findings.detail: After building a stall the Inventory Info panel moved from the left column to the middle of the screen over the well and stayed there. The objective 7 progress bar reads 'nbers 3/10 - Buildings 0/2' (clipped on the left). A huge white floating label '... here, 3/8 residents' is drawn behind the top HUD and cut off at the screen top. Market Info panel also overruns the Season panel when not in the settlement view.
findings.repro: enter own settlement, press B to build a stall, take a screenshot

findings.title: WORKS: residents leave my market to me and 'Build a market stall' completes only from my own stall
findings.detail: With 3/8 residents in Southtown, Market Info stayed at 0/4 stalls and objective 6 stayed open until I pressed B (tick 6896 'Stall built.', objective completed tick 6900). Oscar Smith's stall built in rival Blackfield at tick 6800 did not complete it. After my build a resident (Nancy Walker) only staffs the stall as merchant. Logged as a positive confirmation.
findings.repro: as above; watch Market Info and objective 6 before/after B

verdict: The stall fix holds: residents don't build in the leader's market, and the objective completes only from the player's own B press. The trade loop itself dead-ends, though: a new market's merchant has 0 coins and no stock, so you can't buy or sell, while the panel shows prices as if you could. Caravans are hidden behind Town era, so 'trade and caravans' can't be done in a short session. The game also ran at 3-14 tps here, which made gathering 70+ wood a slog.
